messages:
vivian_billing: Flagging INV-2026-678 for Solaris Labs. Customer flagged ~$2,150 in burst charges across 2026-09-14 during a cross-region migration. They insist their reserved commit should have covered it. Ops: can you pull meter rows and confirm whether this is misattribution before we promise any SLA credit?

omar_ops: On it. I can see a migration at 04:40 UTC that reprovisioned nodes in APAC. Some sessions arrived on nodes that never received the commit metadata due to a race in the bootstrap orchestration. Preliminary meter dump below.

vivian_billing: Please include invoice line ids so I can match to INV-2026-678. Need cents to draft provisional memo.

omar_ops: Meter extract (trimmed):
```
line_id,customer,commit_id,region,usage_tokens,charge_cents,tag
L31,solaris,commit-SR-3,eu-west-1,0,0,reserved
L32,solaris,commit-SR-3-temp,ap-southeast-1,640000,120000,burst
L33,solaris,commit-SR-3,ap-southeast-1,360000,95000,shared
L34,solaris,commit-SR-3-temp,ap-southeast-1,120000,10000,burst
```
Sum of burst/shared shown = 120000 + 95000 + 10000 = 225000 cents => $2,250, which is slightly higher than customer's $2,150 claim (likely token vs sec rounding). Root cause: commit metadata missing on bootstrapped nodes and one duplicate ingestion from a retry loop. Filed INFRA-9587 for bootstrap race.

simon_recon: Finance needs a conservative provisional amount and GL code. If we reprocess and dedupe, we may absorb most of it. Propose provisional credit $2,250 (GL 6110). Approve?

rachel_cs: AM reports customer is upset and wants an immediate acknowledgement and a remedial credit while we investigate. CS prefers issuing a provisional credit up to $2,300 to speed the response.

vivian_billing: I'm uncomfortable issuing the full amount without a reprocess ticket. Finance will approve provisional credit up to $2,300 pending reprocess and final reconciliation. Create memo status=pending-reprocess. Need ops to queue reprocess with dedupe+tag-fix and post job id here.

omar_ops: Queuing reprocess: `infra-billing reprocess --customer solaris --start 2026-09-14T04:30Z --end 2026-09-14T06:00Z --fix-tags --dedupe`

billing-bot: Action acknowledged: "billing reprocess queued (job_id: br-20260914-777). ETA ~8m." :robot_face:

infra-bot: INFRA-9587 created: "bootstrap metadata race causes commit tag loss during migration". Assigned to @omar_ops.

vivian_billing: Drafting provisional credit memo PC-2026-810 for $2,300, status=pending-reprocess, referencing INV-2026-678 and br-20260914-777. Notifying AM with conciliatory note.

rachel_cs: I've informed the AM: "We've identified an issue during the migration that may have caused misattribution. We've issued a provisional credit while we reprocess usage and will confirm final amounts within 24 hours."

billing-bot: br-20260914-777 completed: "reprocess finished: 3 meter rows reclassified to reserved, 1 duplicate removed, invoice re-aggregation scheduled (agg_id: agg-20260914-33)."

omar_ops: Re-agg posted. Updated invoice lines show the shared/burst rows moved back to reserved and duplicate row removed. Visible delta: billed overage reduced to $0. Final outstanding after re-agg = $0.

simon_recon: Reconciled. Void provisional credit PC-2026-810 and mark resolved. Add note: "Reprocess absorbed misattributed usage; no customer credit required." GL reversal done to 6102 (Provisionals) per policy.

vivian_billing: Voided PC-2026-810 and updated INV-2026-678 notes. Thanks ops for fast turnaround. Rachel, can CS confirm with customer and close the dispute?

rachel_cs: Will confirm with AM and send closure note: "We reprocessed your usage and removed the misattributed charges; no outstanding balance remains. We're tracking a fix in INFRA-9587 and will follow up once resolved."

vivian_billing: Closing thread after AM confirmation. Good job all. :tada:
